task: Your neighbour says hello over the fence. Agree and add a small detail.
say: Morning! Lovely day, isn't it?
zh: 邻居隔着篱笆跟你打招呼。表示同意，再加一个小细节。对方说：“早上好！天气真好，是吧？”
example: Morning! Yeah, it's gorgeous. I'm finally going to get the washing out.

task: Your neighbour sees you in the driveway. Answer and ask back.
say: Off to work?
zh: 邻居在车道上看到你。回答，再反问对方。对方说：“去上班啊？”
example: Yep, another day, another dollar. Are you working today too?

task: You arrive at a BBQ. The host offers you a drink. Thank them and offer to help.
say: Grab a drink, there's beer and soft drinks in the chilly bin.
zh: 你到了烧烤聚会，主人请你喝东西。道谢，再主动提出帮忙。对方说：“自己拿喝的吧，冷藏箱里有啤酒和汽水。”
example: Cheers, I'll grab a ginger beer. Can I help with anything?

task: You arrive at a friend's birthday party. Reply warmly.
say: Thanks so much for coming!
zh: 你到了朋友的生日聚会。热情地回应。对方说：“太谢谢你能来了！”
example: Of course, I wouldn't miss it! Happy birthday. What a great turnout.

task: At school pick-up, another parent starts chatting. Answer and ask back.
say: Hi! Which one's yours?
zh: 接孩子放学时，另一位家长跟你聊天。回答，再反问。对方说：“嗨！哪个是你家的？”
example: That's my daughter, Mia, in the pink jacket. Which one's yours?

task: Your neighbour asks about the garden. Answer with a detail.
say: How's the veggie garden going?
zh: 邻居问你菜园怎么样了。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“你的菜园怎么样了？”
example: Slowly! The tomatoes are doing well, but something keeps eating my lettuce.

task: At a BBQ, a guest asks the classic question. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: So how do you know the host?
zh: 烧烤聚会上，一位客人问了个常见问题。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“你是怎么认识主人的？”
example: We work together, actually. Same team for about three years now. How about you?

task: You arrive at a housewarming. Answer and give a compliment about the house.
say: Welcome! Come in, come in. Did you find it okay?
zh: 你去参加乔迁聚会。回答，再夸一下房子。对方说：“欢迎！快进来。好找吗？”
example: Yeah, no problem at all. Wow, this place looks amazing! Look at all that light.

task: A friend of a friend asks about your job at a party. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: What do you do?
zh: 派对上，朋友的朋友问你的工作。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“你是做什么的？”
example: I work in IT, mostly building internal tools for big companies. Pretty nerdy stuff. What about you?

task: It's a bring-a-plate party. The host says you didn't need to bring food. Reply lightly.
say: Oh, you didn't have to bring anything!
zh: 这是一个各自带菜的聚会。主人说你不用带东西。轻松地回应。对方说：“哎呀，你不用带东西的！”
example: It's nothing, just a salad. Nothing fancy, but at least there'll be something green on the table.

task: Someone loves the dumplings you brought to a party. Accept the compliment.
say: These dumplings are amazing. Did you make them?
zh: 有人很喜欢你带到聚会的饺子。接受夸奖。对方说：“这饺子太好吃了，是你包的吗？”
example: Thanks! Yeah, I did. It's my mum's recipe. She'd be stoked to hear that.

task: Your neighbour asks about last night's storm. Answer with a detail.
say: Did that wind keep you up last night?
zh: 邻居问起昨晚的大风。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“昨晚的风把你吵醒了吗？”
example: Yeah, it woke me at about two. I think our wheelie bin ended up in your yard, sorry!

task: At a party, someone asks a fun question. Answer with a reason and ask back.
say: So are you a cat person or a dog person?
zh: 派对上有人问了个有趣的问题。回答并说明原因，再反问。对方说：“你喜欢猫还是喜欢狗？”
example: Total dog person. We had one growing up and I really miss having one around. What about you?

task: A new neighbour introduces themselves. Welcome them, offer help and ask a question.
say: Hi, I'm Dave. We've just moved in next door.
zh: 新邻居来做自我介绍。欢迎对方，主动提供帮助，再问一个问题。对方说：“嗨，我是 Dave，我们刚搬到你隔壁。”
example: Hi Dave, welcome to the street! Where have you moved from? Let me know if you need anything.

task: At a kids' birthday party, another parent chats to you. Agree with humour and ask a question.
say: My two are absolutely hyper from all the sugar.
zh: 在孩子的生日会上，另一位家长跟你聊天。幽默地表示同意，再问一个问题。对方说：“我家两个吃了太多糖，兴奋得不行。”
example: Ha, mine too. I think we'll all sleep well tonight. Was the cake homemade? It looked amazing.

task: At a BBQ, a guest tells you about the food. Show interest with a follow-up question.
say: Have you tried the lamb? Gary's been marinating it since yesterday.
zh: 烧烤聚会上，一位客人跟你聊食物。表示兴趣，再追问一个问题。对方说：“你尝过羊肉了吗？Gary 从昨天就开始腌了。”
example: Not yet, but it smells incredible. Do you know what he put in it?

task: Your neighbour sees you washing the car. Answer, add a detail and ask for advice.
say: Getting the car ready for a road trip?
zh: 邻居看到你在洗车。回答，加个细节，再请教对方。对方说：“在准备自驾游吗？”
example: Yeah, we're driving to Napier for the long weekend. Any tips on good places to stop?

task: Your friend has just moved in. They apologise for the mess. Reassure them and give a compliment.
say: We're still unpacking, so excuse the mess.
zh: 朋友刚搬家，为家里乱道歉。安慰对方，再夸一句。对方说：“我们还在拆箱，家里乱，别介意。”
example: Oh, don't worry, it looks great. I love how much sun you get in the lounge.

task: At school pick-up, a parent asks about the school fair. Answer and ask back.
say: Are you going to the school fair on Saturday?
zh: 接孩子时，一位家长问你去不去学校义卖会。回答，再反问。对方说：“你周六去学校义卖会吗？”
example: I think so, the kids won't let me miss it. Are you helping out on one of the stalls?

task: Your neighbour likes your roses. Accept the compliment and share a tip.
say: Your roses look fantastic this year.
zh: 邻居夸你的玫瑰。接受夸奖，再分享一个小窍门。对方说：“你家玫瑰今年开得真好。”
example: Thanks! They took me ages. I think the secret's all the coffee grounds I've been putting on them.

task: At a BBQ, a friend of a friend asks about your hobbies. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: So what do you get up to for fun?
zh: 烧烤聚会上，朋友的朋友问你的爱好。回答并加一个细节，再反问。对方说：“你平时喜欢玩什么？”
example: I've just got into mountain biking, actually. Mostly falling off, to be honest. What about you?

task: Your neighbour suggests sharing the cost of a new fence. Show interest and ask for details.
say: We're thinking of putting in a new fence. Would you be keen to go halves?
zh: 邻居提议一起分摊新篱笆的费用。表示有兴趣，再问细节。对方说：“我们想换个新篱笆，你愿意一人一半吗？”
example: Yeah, could be keen. Have you got a rough idea what it'd cost? I'll have a chat with my partner tonight.

task: A guest at a party says they are tired. React with humour and ask a follow-up question.
say: This is my third party this weekend. I'm shattered.
zh: 派对上一位客人说很累。幽默地回应，再追问一个问题。对方说：“这是我这周末第三个派对了，累死了。”
example: Wow, you're popular! Three in one weekend? What were the other two for?

task: At a birthday party, your friend introduces their sister. Show interest with a follow-up question.
say: Have you met my sister? She's just back from five years in London.
zh: 生日聚会上，朋友介绍他的姐姐给你认识。表示兴趣，追问一个问题。对方说：“你见过我姐吗？她在伦敦待了五年刚回来。”
example: No, I haven't! Hi, nice to meet you. Five years, wow. What made you come back?

task: At a housewarming, the host makes a joke about the price. React with light humour and ask a question.
say: We had to sell a kidney to afford this place.
zh: 乔迁聚会上，主人拿房价开玩笑。轻松幽默地回应，再问一个问题。对方说：“为了买这房子，我们差点卖肾了。”
example: Ha, well, worth it. Seriously though, it's a beautiful spot. Are you planning to do much to it?

task: At school pick-up, a parent asks about after-school activities. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: Do yours do any after-school stuff?
zh: 接孩子时，一位家长问你孩子有没有课外活动。回答并加一个细节，再反问。对方说：“你家孩子放学后有参加什么活动吗？”
example: My son does swimming on Wednesdays. We're trying to get him into football too. What about yours?

task: At a BBQ, someone is shocked you have never had pavlova. Answer with humour.
say: Wait, you've never had a proper Kiwi pav?
zh: 烧烤聚会上，有人惊讶你从没吃过奶油蛋白饼。幽默地回答。对方说：“等等，你从来没吃过正宗的新西兰 pav？”
example: Never! I know, I know. Hand me a big slice and I'll make up for lost time.

task: At a party, someone gives a strong food opinion. Disagree politely with humour.
say: Pineapple on pizza is a crime, right?
zh: 派对上有人发表了一个很强烈的饮食观点。幽默地礼貌表示不同意。对方说：“披萨上放菠萝简直是犯罪，对吧？”
example: Ha, sorry, I'm on team pineapple. Sweet and salty together, you can't beat it.

task: A friend of a friend finds out you work in IT and asks for help. Deflect with humour.
say: Oh, you're in IT? Could you have a look at my laptop sometime?
zh: 朋友的朋友知道你做 IT，想让你帮忙。幽默地推开。对方说：“哦，你做 IT 的？哪天能帮我看看电脑吗？”
example: Ha, everyone asks that! I'm more on the cloud side, so honestly I'm no better than Google. Have you tried turning it off and on?

task: At a party, someone asks you for a funny story. Tell a short personal story.
say: What's the funniest thing that's happened since you moved here?
zh: 派对上有人想听趣事。讲一个简短的个人经历。对方说：“你搬来这里以后遇到过最好笑的事是什么？”
example: My first week here, someone said bring a plate, so I turned up with an empty plate! Everyone laughed, but they still fed me.

task: Your neighbour apologises for a noisy party. React kindly with light humour.
say: Sorry about the noise last night. It was my son's twenty-first.
zh: 邻居为昨晚吵闹的聚会道歉。友善、幽默地回应。对方说：“昨晚太吵了，不好意思。是我儿子的二十一岁生日。”
example: Oh, no stress at all. Sounded like a great night! Hope he's not feeling too rough today.

task: You are leaving a party early. The host notices. Leave politely and thank them.
say: You're not leaving already, are you?
zh: 你要提前离开派对，主人注意到了。礼貌地告别并道谢。对方说：“你不是这么早就要走吧？”
example: I'm afraid so, early start tomorrow. Thanks so much for having us. It was a great night.

task: At a dinner party, a guest asks you and your partner a question. Tell a short story.
say: So how did you two meet?
zh: 晚宴上，一位客人问你和伴侣一个问题。讲一个小故事。对方说：“你们俩是怎么认识的？”
example: On a tramping trip, actually. A group of us got lost for two hours, and we just kept talking. Best wrong turn I ever took.

task: At a kids' party, another parent makes a comment. Agree lightly and share a short story.
say: Is it just me, or are kids' parties getting fancier every year?
zh: 孩子的派对上，另一位家长发表了看法。轻松地同意，再讲一个小故事。对方说：“是我的错觉吗？孩子的派对一年比一年隆重。”
example: Oh, totally. My son went to one last month with a bouncy castle and a magician. I'm a bit scared for his turn.

task: At a party, a guest admits they find small talk hard. Reassure them with humour and keep the chat going.
say: I'm terrible at small talk. I never know what to say.
zh: 派对上，一位客人说自己不擅长闲聊。幽默地安慰对方，并把话题继续下去。对方说：“我特别不会闲聊，总不知道说什么。”
example: Ha, you're doing fine so far! Honestly, me too. Let's just talk about the food. Have you tried the spring rolls?

task: Your neighbour asks you a favour. Say yes and ask for the details.
say: Would you mind keeping an eye on the place while we're away?
zh: 邻居请你帮个忙。答应，再问清楚细节。对方说：“我们出门这段时间，你能帮忙照看一下房子吗？”
example: Of course, happy to. When are you off? Do you want me to grab the mail and put the bins out too?

task: At a party, someone heard about your bungy jump. Tell a short, lively story.
say: I heard you did a bungy jump last year. Is that true?
zh: 派对上，有人听说你去年玩了蹦极。讲一个简短生动的故事。对方说：“听说你去年去蹦极了，真的吗？”
example: It's true! I stood on the edge for about five minutes. In the end the guy just counted down and I went. Never again, but I'm glad I did it.

task: At a BBQ, a friend teases you about last time. Laugh it off with humour.
say: Didn't you burn the sausages last time?
zh: 烧烤聚会上，朋友拿上次的事取笑你。一笑置之，幽默回应。对方说：“上次不就是你把香肠烤焦了吗？”
example: Guilty! In my defence, someone was telling a very good story. I'll stay well away from the barbie today.

task: You are leaving a dinner and the host gives you leftovers. Accept, thank them warmly and say goodbye.
say: Before you go, you have to take some leftovers!
zh: 你要离开晚宴，主人要给你打包剩菜。接受，热情地道谢并告别。对方说：“走之前一定要带点剩菜回去！”
example: Oh, go on then, twist my arm. Thanks so much for tonight, the food was amazing. Next one's at our place.

task: A friend of a friend asks what your IT job really is. Explain it simply, with a bit of humour, and ask back.
say: So what do you actually do all day? I've never understood IT jobs.
zh: 朋友的朋友问你做 IT 到底每天干什么。简单、带点幽默地解释，再反问对方。对方说：“你每天到底在干嘛？我一直搞不懂 IT 的工作。”
example: Ha, fair question! Basically I make sure our apps don't fall over, and when they do, I get the phone call. What about you, what's a normal day like?
